fields.label: Target points per cloud
fields.help: Registration subsample size per cloud (count-based), or 'auto' for SPACING-DRIVEN: the same registration spacing (~2x the coarser native) is requested for both clouds, verified, and hard-capped at 1.5M pts. Minimum 2000.

fields.label: Coarse mode
fields.help: auto = SCENE-style top-view correlation (no user interaction, but falls back to the GUI if placement quality is poor); gui = manual pick + nudge tool; none = clouds already roughly placed. IGNORED by the 'register' action, which always uses the supplied coarse transform.

fields.label: Quick coarse 'tx ty tz yaw_deg'
fields.help: Quick coarse transform as four numbers (overrides coarse mode). Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Coarse grid cell (m)
fields.help: Top-view grid cell size in metres for auto coarse. Empty = automatic (ricp default None).

fields.label: Skip tilt fit
fields.help: Skip the DEM-difference roll/pitch estimation that runs after coarse placement.

fields.label: Max tilt (deg)
fields.help: Sanity bound in degrees for the tilt fit (the fit self-validates; this only rejects the physically absurd).
